info.title: prusa-connect-local-bot
info.description: The routes of the Slack module. Every path is relative to the mount the host assigns, /api/v1/modules/<namespace>, and the host serves this document rebased under it at <mount>/openapi.json.

get.description: The module's version and SDK version, when it started, the state of its Slack connection, of its status messages, of its account features and of the membership sweep, and the settings it still needs. It never carries a token. The host takes view_resource on the module's instance before this is called.

sdk_version.description: The version of the Prusa Connect SDK it was built with.

slack.description: The Slack connection as the module last saw it.

state.description: not configured, connecting, connected, retrying, or token refused.

detail.description: Why, for a connection that is not working.

team.description: The workspace ID the bot token belongs to.

missing.description: The settings the module still needs, by key.

notify.description: The status messages to the status channel.

running.description: Whether the module is following the server's events.

last_event.description: When the last event was applied.

detail.description: Why the messages are off, or what failed last.

accounts.description: on, or off and why: the account features need admin_password and the state file.

sweep.description: What the membership sweep last did and when the next full sweep is, while account features are on.

get.summary: A one-time code that links a Slack user to your account
get.description: Opened in a browser from the address the bot sends in a Slack direct message, with ?for=<nonce>. For a signed-in person it answers a one-time code, valid 10 minutes, and says which Slack user it links to which account; the person types the code in Slack. The nonce is single-use. The host takes view_resource on the module's instance before this is called.

parameters.name: for
parameters.description: The nonce from the bot's direct message.

403.description: The caller is not a person's account.

404.description: The address expired or was used already.
